customManagers.description: Immich APP version pinned in the chart values (controllers.main.containers.main.image.tag)
argo-cd install: the pinned upstream manifest URL in kubernetes/bootstrap/argocd/kustomization.yaml
Generic '# renovate: datasource=… depName=…' comments above a version line (e.g. KUBECONFORM_VERSION in the CI workflow)

packageRules.description: Label everything so PRs are easy to spot
Major bumps always get their own PR + a loud label
DB-migration-sensitive apps: never automerge, flag clearly (Immich chart+image+postgres, RomM, Kavita, Calibre)
Stateless apps: PATCH + DIGEST bumps land in ONE weekly PR so there is a single thing to read on Monday. Never automerged — you review, you merge, you Sync.

qBittorrent is pinned to LinuxServer's IMMUTABLE tag (5.3.0_v2.1.2-ls485) rather than the moving '5.3.0', so the default docker/semver versioning can't read it. Groups: app version, then the LSIO rebuild number as 'build'. The libtorrent part (_v2.1.2) is matched but not captured — it tracks the app version anyway. Scoped to qbittorrent on purpose: Kavita's LSIO tags are a different shape (version-vX.Y.Z.W).

Meilisearch is a COMPONENT OF Karakeep, not an app in its own right: its on-disk index format is tied to the engine version, and karakeep/deployment.yaml deliberately pins whatever Karakeep's own docker-compose pins. Automatic PRs here would walk it ahead of Karakeep and silently break the index, so they are off. Bump it by hand when a Karakeep release changes its compose: https://github.com/karakeep-app/karakeep/blob/main/docker/docker-compose.yml

karakeep-chrome tags are <chrome-version>-r<revision> (e.g. 156.0.8078.47-r1), where -r is bumped for packaging-only rebuilds. Default docker versioning treats a changed suffix as incompatible and would silently stop offering updates the day -r2 ships, so parse it explicitly.
Argo CD: one PR per upstream release (the pinned install URL). You merge, then re-apply kubernetes/bootstrap/argocd/ by hand — never automerged
cert-manager: upstream says upgrade ONE minor at a time → one PR per minor stream (merge + Sync in order, read each release's upgrade notes)
